programs.englishRequirement: TOEFL 86, IELTS 6.0, A Level BBC or above, satisfactory GRE scores, equivalent proof, or official proof that high school instruction was fully in English.
programs.tuitionText: 49,750 RMB per academic year; full-year tuition is charged for the first semester and semester-based payment thereafter.
programs.applicationNote: Applicants need a high school diploma and good health. Applicants under 18 need a notarized guardianship certificate after UIBE approval. Recurring periods: Spring, October 20–December 31; Fall, March 20–June 30 each year. Confirm the applicable intake year before applying.
